Subject: SSO / SCIM technical details and next steps

Hi Sam — Monica from Redwood security/solutions here. Following up with the technical specs you requested so your SSO engineers can prepare for the test tenant. Summary below and attachments include a short SSO_Onboarding_Guide (steps) and SCIM schema examples. 

SSO (SAML 2.0)
- Metadata endpoint (SP): https://sso.redwoodinference.com/metadata/bw-test
- IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows supported.
- Recommended NameID format: persistent or email.
- Attributes we send by default: email, givenName, familyName, role, department, employeeId. Custom claims can be configured.

SCIM provisioning
- Endpoints: https://scim.redwoodinference.com/v2/
- Supports users and groups endpoints, pagination, incremental sync via "lastModified" filter.
- Group support: yes — groups/{id}/members and /Groups endpoint available. We recommend mapping your AD groups to Redwood roles for RBAC.

RBAC & admin controls
- Built-in roles: Owner (full), Admin (manage users & settings), Manager (access to model routes and team configs), Viewer (read-only).
- Delegated admin: supported via scoped admin tokens.
- Audit logging: admin actions and provisioning events retained 365 days by default; exports available on request.

Test plan proposal
1) We provision a Brightwell test tenant and provide a metadata file for your IdP.
2) Your SSO engineer does IdP connection in staging; we validate attributes and role mapping with a smoke test user.
3) SCIM: do a full user import, then incremental update to validate group mapping.

Attachments: SSO_Onboarding_Guide.pdf, SCIM_schema_examples.json (sample payloads).

If this works, Tessa/Rishi can schedule the 45-min session; we can have the tenant ready by Monday morning PT.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
